Subject: Launch support ask and commercial sweetener

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency and the reliability you showed. We're ramping toward a pilot go-live in early January and I'm trying to pull together the commercial package to present to our CFO next week. Two asks from our side: one, would Redwood consider 500k tokens of free credits to seed the pilot usage so our engineers can iterate on prompts without rate concerns; and two, a 60-day extension of the 30-day trial window so we can validate production metrics across our staging environments?

Budget is tight and our procurement lead needs to see a launch/intro concession to sign off. If there's any flexibility on a first-year discount (we were hoping for ~20%) that would make the economics compelling. Happy to jump on a 20-min call to align.

I attached a short SOW draft the team pulled together for background.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz

Neuroforge Labs

Hi Lena —

Really appreciate the clear ask and the SOW — excited to support Neuroforge's pilot. Quick response on internal feasibility: 500k tokens is above our standard introductory grant, and a 60-day trial extension is possible in many cases but typically requires an accompanying qualifying commit or a signed statement of work.

Proposed next steps from my side: I want to pull together a recommended concession package and escalate for exec clearance. Can you confirm: (1) estimated pilot peak QPS and total projected token usage over the 60 days, (2) procurement timeline (do you need a signed document by mid-November?), and (3) whether Neuroforge can commit to a 12-month purchase window post-pilot (not a firm dollar commit, just intent)?

If you can do a quick call this afternoon I can give you a sense of what to expect.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Team — looping you in. Neuroforge (Lena Ortiz) asked for: 500k free tokens + 60-day trial extension + ~20% first-year discount. They target pilot go-live early Jan and procurement wants to see concessions by mid-November.

Quick background/ask: This is a strategic AI infrastructure account (healthcare+edge inference use cases) — potential to grow into multi-cloud dedicated capacity later this year. My recommended package to propose for exec approval: 200k complimentary tokens, 45-day extension (on top of standard 30 days), and a 15% first-year subscription discount. Condition: customer signs SOW and a 12-month commitment letter (minimum term). Estimated cost to Redwood vs. uplift: roughly $18k in token subsidy plus marginal discount on first-year ARR.

I've attached a one-pager MAAP showing usage profile and a draft SOW with the specific deliverables. Requesting exec signoff or guidance on the numbers.

Thanks — Mina
Attachment: Neuroforge_MAAP_v1.pdf, SOW_draft.docx
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 11:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Launch support ask — Neuroforge Labs — request for exec clearance

Mina —

Thanks for the summary. I'm sympathetic to the strategic value here but want to be mindful of precedent and margin. 200k tokens + 45 days + 15% is a reasonable starting point, but I would push to cap the free credits at 150k unless we attach a clear upsell trigger. Specifically: 150k credits + 45-day extension + 12% first-year discount. If Neuroforge provides a co-sell intro to two named prospects or agrees to a joint case study within 6 months, we can make an additional 50k tokens available as an accelerant.

Please confirm whether procurement needs formal CFO-level approval or if PO-signature suffices. If they insist on the 500k number we should request a purchase commitment in the SOW for a larger discount, otherwise it's too dilutive.

David
VP, Customer Success
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Launch support ask — Neuroforge Labs — request for exec clearance

Team — after reviewing the MAAP and the pilot timelines I approve David's compromise with one addition: make the 12% discount conditional on Neuroforge signing a 12-month contract with a $100k ARR minimum. If they meet the co-sell/case-study commitment, approve the extra 50k tokens (for a total of 200k). We'll document the escalation path in the SOW: additional credits will be released in two tranches tied to completion milestones (integration + first production month).

Mina — please proceed to send the concession offer to Lena with the conditions spelled out (12-month $100k min commit OR equivalent procurement sign-off; credits staged; DocuSign for the SOW). Copy finance (Marissa) for tracking.

Aditya
